_layout_comment: Uncomment/fill in 'layout' below only when switching to a DIFFERENT background image that needs its row/timer positions recalibrated. Leave omitted to use the built-in defaults tuned for bg.jpg. Shape: { row:{y0,pitch,h}, colName:{x,w}, colWin:{x,w}, timer:{right,top,size} } -- all numbers measured against a 1920x1080 canvas (right/top/size as percent of canvas, x/w/y0/pitch/h as px).
